'''Rakatan annihilators''' were large walkers used by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in their conquests. Shaped similar to the [[Star Forge]] like most Rakatan vehicles, Annihilators walked on two legs with a central sphere between them; the sphere featured two smaller lasers that complemented the large destructive beam that could be generated from its underside. A thin red viewport spanned the sphere. Annihilators were deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shikaakwa]] in [[25,792 BBY]] during the [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], though they were destroyed by [[Je'daii]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="DOTJ 11" />
